key_insight: Uncertainty-based sampling generally improves training-data acquisition, but the best strategy depends on the model, dataset, and prediction task.
engineering_relevance: Task-specific data acquisition can help allocate limited labelling budgets more efficiently for molecular and materials property prediction.
method: Compare random sampling with multiple active learning strategies.
Evaluate across model classes, representations, datasets, and target properties.
Derive strategy-selection guidelines for a given labelling budget.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation across diverse modelling settings, with uncertainty-based sampling generally outperforming alternatives, but provides no quantitative gains.
watch_item: Validate acquisition strategies in the intended prediction setting rather than assuming one approach will perform best universally.
paper_title: Systematic Evaluation of Training Data Generation Strategies for Machine Learning-Based Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
